name: DeviceNetworkEvents
description: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint network connection and communication telemetry

columns.name: Timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the network event occurred

columns.name: DeviceName
columns.description: Hostname or FQDN of the device

columns.name: RemotePort
columns.description: Destination port (e.g. 445 for SMB, 443 for HTTPS)

columns.name: LocalIP
columns.description: Source IP of the sending host

columns.name: InitiatingProcessFileName
columns.description: Process that initiated the network traffic

columns.name: InitiatingProcessCommandLine
columns.description: Command line of the initiating process

columns.name: InitiatingProcessAccountName
columns.description: User account that owns the initiating process
